Sherman Library & Gardens — 2647 East Coast Hwy, Corona del Mar, CA 92625; (949) 673-2261. Major research archive on the Pacific Southwest incl. Irvine Ranch & Orange County land/agriculture photos and documents.
Orange County Archives — Old Orange County Courthouse, 211 W. Santa Ana Blvd, Room 105, Santa Ana, CA 92701; (714) 973-4880. Historical Orange County photographs and records.
First American Corporation historical photo/map collection (First American Title) — Santa Ana, CA. Large Orange County historical photograph and land-title/map archive (access by arrangement).
Irvine Historical Society / Irvine Ranch Historical Museum (San Joaquin Ranch adobe) — Irvine, CA. Ranch-era artifacts and photographs.
Bowers Museum — 2002 N. Main St, Santa Ana, CA 92706; (714) 567-3600. Orange County history collections.
The Irvine Company corporate archives — private; historic Irvine Ranch records/photographs held by the successor company (not publicly catalogued).
